semantics: Render the complete canonical schedule-bound board. Never reinterpret as best bets, strongest leans, plays-only, recap, or executive summary.
rules: Retrieve the canonical schedule for the resolved local card date.
Render every canonical scheduled event exactly once in chronological order.
Render every required core market for each event.
NO_MODEL and POST_START rows are visible and count toward completeness.
POST_START cannot create a new prospective forecast.
Run full-card completeness and forecast-action governance before rendering.
If validation fails, emit CARD_REJECTED with missing event IDs, missing market types, duplicates, and governance errors; never render a partial card as complete.
Render PLAY-only action rows only after the complete full card.
Illustrative/sample probabilities are forbidden in production card output.

related_intents.SHOWCASE_ACTION_CARD: PLAY rows only, derived from a validated full card
related_intents.SHOWCASE_DIAGNOSTICS: NO_MODEL, NO_PRICE, BLOCKED, stale evidence, divergence and completeness failures
related_intents.SETTLE_FORECAST_CARD: Append grades to frozen forecasts without mutating forecast payloads

completion_condition: all canonical events rendered AND all required markets rendered AND every row has explicit status AND completeness validator passes AND forecast-action governance passes
